outcome.strictNoDevice: Actual OPI0x4040 read at MSPI3 start is rejected without caller-supplied device. No default MISO data or implicit identity.

explicitTestDevice.basis: Explicit reference AP-compatible test-device configuration,not observed Plus silicon/reset values. Identity/good-die/density bytes are declared input; backing capacity is independent,not inferred.

outcome.interpretation: Original guest performs real mode-register and backing-memory transactions,prints PSRAM information from the explicit reference input,then reaches multicore initialization. One-hart bringup is not completed multicore/product startup.

storage: firmware bytes only in host/guest RAM and subprocess pipe; not written to disk
limits: No confirmation of the Plus physical PSRAM die. Strict mode remains without an attached device.
Delay/drive/DLL tuning fields are configuration. Functional reads return actual stored bytes for represented settings; not analog timing-margin/thermal/calibration evidence.
No enabled PSRAM IRQ routing,ECC,low-power/reset protocol or timing/contended queue model.
No complete multicore startup,product peripherals or framebuffer. Plus remains unavailable.
retainedInitialResults: Initial no-device and first reference-device probes retained by original hashes; final-source controls repeat both paths. Earlier register status/ECC review narrowed unsupported behavior before final validation.
privacy: CPU register dump and duplicate USB data omitted. Raw sizes/hashes retained. Public UART contains reference-device information,not host or physical-device identifiers.
